opportunities.name: Low-health Bloodmail swing
opportunities.objective: Test low-health bloodmail swing against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Berserker Rage gains attack speed/lifesteal with missing health, while Bloodmail gains AD as health falls; Reckless Swing adds 0.5 total AD true damage and attacks refund its cooldown. Visage supports lifesteal and Tough It Out's missing-health shield during Ragnarok contact.
opportunities.requiredState: Reach low health safely with R ready and champion attacks connected.
opportunities.failure: Execution burst kills him before sustain, or kiting ends Ragnarok.
opportunities.test: Compare E casts and healing at fixed low-health percentages.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Low health is a controlled test condition, not free permanent maximum Bloodmail value.

opportunities.name: Axe Spellblade caster
opportunities.objective: Test axe spellblade caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Picking up Undertow caps its cooldown at the documented short interval; Trinity rewards an attack between axe throws while Shojin supports Q/E repetition. Cleaver accompanies Q's armor removal, but Reckless Swing remains true damage and does not benefit armor penetration.
opportunities.requiredState: Retrieve axes without abandoning champion contact.
opportunities.failure: Bad axe placement makes the build's haste and Spellblade rhythm inaccessible.
opportunities.test: Count Q and E casts with safe versus obstructed pickups.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Armor reduction does not increase E true damage or make axe cooldown literally zero on every pickup.

ruledOut.reason: Low health is a controlled test condition, not free permanent maximum Bloodmail value.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Low-health Bloodmail swing
builds.summary: Test low-health bloodmail swing against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test low-health bloodmail swing against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Berserker Rage gains attack speed/lifesteal with missing health, while Bloodmail gains AD as health falls; Reckless Swing adds 0.5 total AD true damage and attacks refund its cooldown. Visage supports lifesteal and Tough It Out's missing-health shield during Ragnarok contact.
testPlan: Required state: Reach low health safely with R ready and champion attacks connected.
Compare E casts and healing at fixed low-health percentages.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Execution burst kills him before sustain, or kiting ends Ragnarok.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Low health is a controlled test condition, not free permanent maximum Bloodmail value.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Blade of The Ruined King, Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage, Black Cleaver, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Olaf gains [10 / 15 / 20] Armor and [10 / 15 / 20] Magic Resist.

Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for [3] seconds. While active, Olaf gains [10 / 20 / 30 + (0.25) × AD] Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by [2.5] seconds.

Additionally, Olaf gains [(0.2 / 0.45 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed towards enemy champions for [1] second.

Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing [70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 + (0.5) × AD] true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded.

Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.

Olaf throws an axe, dealing [70 / 120 / 170 / 220 / 270 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing by [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × 100]% for up to [3] seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose [20]% Armor for [4] seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to [(2.5) × (runtimeCooldownMultiplier)] seconds, or fully refunded if [(2.5) × (runtimeCooldownMultiplier)] seconds has elapsed.

Olaf gains [(0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8) × 100]% Attack Speed for [5] seconds, and [10 / 40 / 70 / 100 / 130] plus [17.5]% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of [10 / 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 + ((0.175) × ((1 + (-1) × (0.3)))) × Stat(12)] Shield below [30]% Health) for [2.5] seconds.
Olaf gains up to [characterLevelInterpolation(0.5 → 1; raw flags preserved)] Attack Speed and [characterLevelInterpolation(0.08 → 0.25; raw flags preserved)] Life Steal, based on his missing Health.
